title: External Media Requirement Contract
description: Formal contract for location, neighborhood, and POI evidence requirements that cannot be fulfilled by internal property CRM assets alone.

schema.target_entities: array of domain entities (e.g. Taubaté Shopping, Supermercado Shibata, Dutra)
schema.verification_standard: Must visibly show named landmark or verified cartographic route
schema.boundary_rule: Never label unverified atmospheric drone footage as verified geographic proof.
